{{Quote|Finally, a home for Ugnaughts by Ugnaughts.|[[Ozz (Ugnaught)/Legends|King Ozz]]|<ref name="GG3-2">[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back'', Second Edition]]</ref>}}
'''Ugnorgrad''', otherwise known as the '''City of the Ugnaughts''', was the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Ugnaught Surface/Legends|Ugnaught Surface]], a floating colony built by the [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaughts]] in orbit around the planet [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]].

==Characteristics==
Significant locations in Ugnorgrad included the [[Ugnorgrad Performance Hall/Legends|Ugnorgrad Performance Hall]], [[Action Tidings Tower|''Action Tidings'' Tower]], [[Mechanics Union Auxiliary Meeting Hall|Union Hall]], and the start of the [[Ugnorgrad Swampway]] skimmer race course.

==History==
The city was named after the legendary Boss [[Ugnor]], and was the retirement location of many Ugnaughts hailing from the [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] workforce. They preferred Ugnorgrad and the Ugnaught Surface to staying in Cloud City, and also felt no need to travel back to their home [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Gentes/Legends|Gentes]], due to all the time and work spent on the Bespin colonies.

In the early years of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], the Ugnaught [[King/Legends|King]] [[Ozz (Ugnaught)/Legends|Ozz]] was the ruler of Ugnorgrad.
